title: A practical approach to a single-chain variable fragment (scFv) biotinylating for immunohistochemical analysis✰
author: Rodríguez-Nava, Ortuño-Pineda, et al.

steps.title: Dialyze purified scFv
steps.instruction: Dialyze the purified scFv (1 mg/mL) against 0.1 M carbonate buffer (pH 8.0; 30 mM Na₂CO₃, 70 mM NaHCO₃) for 12 h using a dialysis membrane (MWCO 12–14 kDa, Spectrum Cat# 08-700-166) placed in a beaker with a magnetic stir bar; keep the solution gently moving.

steps.title: Prepare biotin‑NHS solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 2 mg of Biotin‑N‑hydroxysuccinimide (Sigma‑Aldrich Cat# 0035‑013‑720) in 1 mL dimethyl‑sulfoxide (DMSO, Sigma‑Aldrich Cat# D8418).

steps.title: Biotinylate scFv
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of the biotin‑NHS solution to the dialyzed scFv (≈33‑fold molar excess) and incubate for 4 h at room temperature in the dark with constant agitation.

steps.title: Dialyze to remove excess biotin
steps.instruction: Remove unbound biotin by dialysis for 12 h at 4 °C using a 12–14 kDa MWCO membrane (Spectrum Cat# 08-700-166) against PBS (pH 7.2) at a 50:1 buffer‑to‑sample ratio (50 mL PBS per 1 mL sample). Replace the PBS the next day and continue dialysis for an additional 20 min. Collect the dialyzed scFv in a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube and store in the dark at –20 °C.

substeps.instruction: Prepare PBS (pH 7.2) by dissolving 8.5 g NaCl (137 mM), 1.15 g Na₂HPO₄ (8.1 mM) and 0.24 g NaH₂PO₄·H₂O (1.7 mM) in 1 L distilled water; adjust pH to 7.2.

steps.title: Deparaffinize tissue slides
steps.instruction: Place paraffin‑embedded cervical tissue slides in a 70 °C incubator for ~15 min until the paraffin becomes liquid, then immediately transfer slides to a Coplin bottle containing 100 % xylene (Hycel CAS:1330‑20‑7).

steps.title: Rehydrate tissue sections
steps.instruction: Rehydrate slides in a metal staining rack by sequential immersion (3 min each) in 100 % xylene, 1:1 xylene‑ethanol, 100 % ethanol, 96 % ethanol, 70 % ethanol, and finally distilled water, taking care to avoid tissue detachment.

steps.title: Heat‑induced antigen retrieval
steps.instruction: Dilute 20× ImmunoDNA Retriever Citrate buffer (BiosB Cat# BSB 0023) 1:20 with distilled water to obtain 1× citrate buffer (pH 6.0). Place slides in a Pascal’s pot (Dako) and heat at 120 °C for 15 min; allow slides to cool to room temperature. Wash slides with PBS‑Tween (0.05 % Tween‑20, Sigma‑Aldrich Cat# P1379) and perform five washes of three minutes each with TBS‑Tween, drying the area around each slide with absorbent paper.

steps.title: Block endogenous peroxidase
steps.instruction: Incubate slides with 3 % hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂, BiosB Cat# SBS0001S) for 30 min at room temperature in a humidity chamber, then wash five times for three minutes each with TBS‑Tween.

steps.title: Incubate with biotinylated scFv
steps.instruction: Dilute the biotinylated scFv to a final concentration of 50 ng/mL in PBS (pH 7.2) and incubate slides for 120 min at room temperature; thereafter wash five times for three minutes each with TBS‑Tween.

steps.title: Streptavidin‑HRP incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate slides with streptavidin conjugated to HRP (BiosB Cat# SBS0001S) for 30 min at room temperature, then wash five times for three minutes each with TBS‑Tween.

steps.title: DAB development and counterstain
steps.instruction: Prepare DAB solution by diluting DAB (BiosB Cat# SBS0001S) 1:50 in DAB diluent (BiosB Cat# SBS0001S). Apply to slides for 30 s, then stop the reaction with distilled water. Stain nuclei with Harry’s Hematoxylin (Hycel Cat# 738) for 30 s and rinse in distilled water.

steps.title: Dehydrate, mount, and dry
steps.instruction: Dehydrate slides by immersing sequentially for 20 min each in 70 % ethanol, 96 % ethanol, 100 % ethanol, 1:1 ethanol‑xylene, and 100 % xylene. Mount with Entellan resin (Merck Cat# 107,961), place a coverslip, and let dry at room temperature.

steps.title: Examine slides under microscope
steps.instruction: Observe the stained sections with a Leica DM1000 LED microscope (Leica Biosystems, Wetzlar, Germany) using 20× and 40× objectives to assess signal localization and immunostaining intensity.
